context:
Goal: review rounds catch real defects at a cost worth paying.
Problem (rule): your Nov 8 ruling gives every guard or check change a third review round and the net-value test, but on 992 measured PRs a third round after a passing second round failed only 4.3% of the time (29 of 675) and never found a change that made things less safe, so only you can say whether that round is worth its cost.
Based on (measured): review records from Oct 26 to Nov 11 (992 PRs, 3,096 reviewed heads), lane review-rounds-rework, draft PR #2874; all 9 changes that made things less safe came after a failed second round.
Based on (ruling): your Nov 8 pick that a guard or check change still gets round 3 after a fix check passes.
Departs from: main gives every guard or check change round 3 — the change gives it round 3 only after a failed second round.
Meanwhile: the lane builds your Nov 7 picks (Sonnet first round for guard and check changes; findings labelled by weight), which also start counting how many findings were real.

lastAnswer.note: message retrospecitve -- this was long since already established

options.gain: You decide on real finding counts, not on pass and fail rates alone; nothing is lost meanwhile.
options.how: Keep round 3 for every guard or check change now; ask again once the new findings counts give one measured sample.
options.label: Wait for the findings count (Recommended)
options.lose: About 675 more Sonnet reviews' worth of cost until the measure comes in.

options.gain: One fewer review on roughly 675 guard or check changes, so they merge sooner and cost less.
options.how: A guard or check change gets round 3 and the net-value test only after its second round fails.
options.label: Round 3 only after a failed round 2, now
options.lose: The 29 defects round 3 caught after a passing round 2 would have merged.

reply: You're right, and I'm sorry for the noise: your Nov 10 ruling already settled this ("yeah i never wanted round 3 if it passed earlier"). I posted it from your older Nov 8 pick without reading the newer one. Withdrawn; the retrospective is told. Step rounds-rules-one-record builds your Nov 10 ruling.
short: Round 3 only after a failed round 2?
title: Should a guard change get a third review round only when its second round failed?
why: It changes your Nov 8 ruling, so it needs your word. Meanwhile the lane's pull request stays a draft.
